description: The sRGB bitmap uses decision 145 leaves refused (phase1.15_compositor-colour-fits item 2.2, decisions 145, 156 and 166), under Legacy on the authored 3x3 plane grid (nine sets) at 256 px, Emissive added as sRGB8 and User1 RGB8, User2 L8, User3 RGB16, User4 L16, User5 RGB16F, User7 RGB32F. s0: the authored 8-bit grey ramp (column x holds code x) on BaseColor set to sRGB, default projection (1:1). s1-s3: field A (16-bit) on BaseColor and the 8-bit srgb8-ramp on Emissive, both set to sRGB, UV projection with wrap Repeat: BilinearHQ at scale (2, 2), rotation 30, offset (0.1, 0.2) (s1); BilinearHQ at scale (0.5, 0.5) (s2); Nearest at scale (2, 2) (s3). s4: User1, User3, User5 and User7 field A and the L channels User2 and User4 grey A (decision 048), each with set_color_space(sRGB) attempted (decision 166: Painter refused it on User1, decision 160; each channel's refusal is recorded). s5: BaseColor uniform (0.2, 0.5, 0.8) sRGB under a black mask whose fill effect's source is grey A, with set_color_space(sRGB) attempted on that source (decision 156: Painter's refusal, if it refuses, is recorded). s6-s8: field A on BaseColor set to Working, Legacy Linear and Legacy sRGB. Captures: get_color_space and list_available_color_spaces of every bitmap. BaseColor, Emissive and the six user channels at PNG 16, PNG 8 and OpenEXR 32f, infinite padding, no dithering, every export step done twice in the session.
